01_parameter_sweep.png.EN: Conditional received green power for 24 optical cases. Bars are means and error bars are one Monte Carlo standard error across three seeds; they are not confidence intervals for device performance.
01_parameter_sweep.png.ZH: 24 組條件下的綠光收光功率。長條為三個蒙地卡羅種子的平均，誤差線為一個標準誤；不是實機效能的信賴區間。

02_floor_maps.png.EN: A: upward excitation power transmitted across the resin–liquid floor under NE illumination. B: isotropic point-source power reaching the PD. Each row shares one color scale across all four wells.
02_floor_maps.png.ZH: A：NE LED 打光時，通過樹脂／液體井底介面的向上激發光。B：各位置等向性光源中有多少功率抵達 PD。同一列四井共用色階。

03_well_transfer.png.EN: Received green power resolved by active LED and the well where fluorescence originated, for the ideal-material bottom-cell-layer model.
03_well_transfer.png.ZH: 在理想材料、底部細胞層假設下，將 PD 收到的綠光依點亮 LED 與螢光來源井分開。

04_detector_angles.png.EN: Cumulative NE green power admitted by artificial detector acceptance cones. Points are three-seed means with ±1 SE.
04_detector_angles.png.ZH: 以人工接受角限制，統計 NE 綠光的累積收光量；點為三種子平均，誤差線為 ±1 SE。

05_frequency_recovery.png.EN: A: ideal noise-free received fluorescence. B: conditional received signal including MC excitation leakage and assumed ambient, photoelectron shot noise and electronics noise. C: overlay. D: received minus ideal.
05_frequency_recovery.png.ZH: A：理想、無雜訊的收到螢光。B：加入 MC 激發漏光與假設環境光、光電子散粒雜訊及電子雜訊。C：疊圖。D：收到訊號減掉理想訊號。

06_conditional_budget.png.EN: Maximum lock-in amplitude RMS noise compatible with an engineering SNR target of five, for the stated optical model and quantum yield 0.6.
06_conditional_budget.png.ZH: 在指定光學模型、量子產率 0.6 下，若工程目標 SNR=5，鎖相振幅所能容許的最大 RMS 雜訊。

07_sample_paths.png.EN: A cutaway rendering of actual sampled NE excitation and fluorescence trajectories. Selected detected fluorescence paths are emphasized; line density is not optical intensity.
07_sample_paths.png.ZH: 剖視圖呈現實際抽樣的 NE 激發及螢光軌跡；特別顯示部分命中 PD 的螢光路徑，線條密度不是光強。

08_volume_standard_validation.png.EN: Row-normalized source-well contributions for a weakly absorbing uniform fluorescent liquid, distinct from a bottom cell layer.
08_volume_standard_validation.png.ZH: 弱吸收、均勻螢光液體的來源井比例，每列正規化；此模型與底部細胞層不同。

09_interference_metrics.png.EN: A: ideal/received amplitude spectra. B: signed amplitude bias and complex relative error after joint four-frequency demodulation. C: signal-to-error ratio including systematic contamination and random noise.
09_interference_metrics.png.ZH: A：理想／收到訊號的振幅頻譜。B：聯合四頻解調後的振幅偏差與複數相對誤差。C：把系統性污染與隨機雜訊一起計入的訊號／誤差比。

10_interference_sweep.png.EN: A/B summarize worst-channel complex error and lowest-channel median SINR at electronic RMS 5 pW/sample and assumed responsivity ratio 0.8. C varies electronic noise; all panels also include assumed photoelectron shot noise.
10_interference_sweep.png.ZH: A／B 固定電子 RMS 5 pW/sample、假設響應度比 0.8，呈現最差通道的複數誤差及最低通道 SINR 中位數；C 改變電子雜訊。所有面板也包含假設的光電子散粒雜訊。

optical_slow_motion.mp4.EN: NE sampled optical paths and four LED state indicators share one time clock with ideal, received, overlaid and residual detector traces. Playback is 100× slow; the 20-second movie covers 0.2 seconds of modulation.
optical_slow_motion.mp4.ZH: NE 抽樣光路、四顆 LED 狀態與理想、收到、疊圖、殘差訊號共用同一時鐘。播放放慢 100 倍，20 秒影片呈現 0.2 秒調變。

optical_slow_motion.gif.EN: NE sampled optical paths and four LED state indicators share one time clock with ideal, received, overlaid and residual detector traces. Playback is 100× slow; the 20-second movie covers 0.2 seconds of modulation.
optical_slow_motion.gif.ZH: NE 抽樣光路、四顆 LED 狀態與理想、收到、疊圖、殘差訊號共用同一時鐘。播放放慢 100 倍，20 秒影片呈現 0.2 秒調變。
